Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE I OF 2004
ORDINANCE I OF
2004
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2004
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province
Public Service
Commission Ordinance, 1978
[Gazette of N.
-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 6th August, 2004]
No. LEGIS. I(20)/73/4750,
dated 6-8-2004.-----The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and
commencement.-----(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Public' Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
